_comment: Cross-service pin for the (hostName, slot) -> broker-name seam. HCC provisions the per-slot egress broker under `brokerName`; mcp-host must reconstruct the SAME name to dial it, with no handshake. The three consumers (HCC reconciler, mcp-host provider factory, @clerum/egress-policy) each assert against these vectors, so a slotId- or hash-scheme change turns all three red at once instead of drifting silently. Do NOT hand-edit slotId/brokerName — regenerate with the command below.
